source.name: WBUR published municipality outlines
source.projection: Publisher-preprojected planar display coordinates; no reprojection or inset transformation.
source.attribution: Municipal outlines: WBUR published reference map. Town/county identifiers: MassGIS.
source.boundary_comparability: All 351 municipality identifiers and county assignments match the authoritative MassGIS table. Underlying boundary vintage is not independently certified.

join: Exact MassGIS town identifier, with source town-name check and the documented Manchester historical-name alias.
transform: Delta-decode TopoJSON arcs using the supplied scale/translate, reverse shared arcs by bitwise-complement index, preserve every polygon/ring with even-odd SVG fill. Rounded display coordinates to 0.001 publisher units.
license_note: Uses the publicly published reference boundary data with source attribution; no blanket license for WBUR content, branding or code is asserted.
